title: Illumina 16S rRNA Gene Sequencing Protocol
author: Vincent Young
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7bzhip6

steps.title: Prepare DNA Samples in PCR Plates
steps.instruction: Add DNA to twin.tec plates in a clean hood, ensuring proper sealing and labeling.

substeps.instruction: Add at least 20 uL of DNA to each well of the twin.tec plates.
Reserve at least two wells in the full-skirted PCR plate for controls (maximum 94 samples per plate).
Seal plates securely with sterile foil seal to reduce evaporation and cross-contamination.
Label plates with PI, Reference ID, and date.

steps.title: Complete Submission Documentation
steps.instruction: Prepare and submit the required administrative documentation for the samples.

substeps.instruction: Send the electronic plate map and shipment tracking information to msmblcore@umich.edu.

steps.title: Ship Samples
steps.instruction: Ship the prepared PCR plates to the specified facility using the provided shipping directions.

substeps.instruction: Ship samples on dry ice or with ice packs.

Address shipment to: Attention: April Cockburn, Mouse Metabolic Phenotyping Centers, University of Michigan Medical School, Internal Medicine/Infectious Diseases, 1500 MSRB11150 W. Medical Center Drive, Ann Arbor, MI 48109-5666.
Include the reference ID on the package documentation.
